title: Command palette
summary: A keyboard-first launcher: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a dialog with a search field over grouped commands, fuzzy-matched with highlights, recents when the field is empty, arrows and Enter to run.

props.name: noShortcut
props.description: Do not bind Ctrl/Cmd+K on the document.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A command was chosen; navigates to href when it has one and the event is not cancelled.

parts.name: list
parts.description: The results list (group headings and option rows are built inside it)

methods.name: items (property)
methods.description: { id, label, group?, hint?, keywords?, href?, shortcut? }[] (property only).

a11y: A native modal dialog; the input is a combobox controlling a listbox with aria-activedescendant; a polite status announces the result count; groups are labelled.
mobile: Full width at the top of the screen; rows are 44px; the list is the only scroller.
